scope: Existing gate resolver; apps/*/src + packages/*/src, literal imports/exports/require plus recursively resolved targets; tests/fixtures excluded by that resolver.
limitations: Type-only imports are excluded from the value graph; TS compiler may also erase value imports used only as types.
Cycle candidates include barrel re-exports; they require manual triage.
Browser aliases follow the architecture gate; per-app aliases and conditional exports are not fully modeled.
Root-only import candidates are ownership evidence, not proof that a package fails to build.
No dead-code claim is made from a module having zero incoming edges.
